name: ldload
description: Shared libc SP4: libc is resident from boot (rc runs ldload); ldload then makes termlib and curses resident from a conf file, pinned; lddig checks each library's banks against the host's layout (every runtime bank byte, a digest per bank); a second ldload finds all three resident.  libfgx is resident from boot too (/etc/ld.so.conf), so the host's layout (ld.digest, fgx_lddigest --boot) places libc and libfgx first and termlib and curses below them.  Control: lddig against a digest made without the boot set (libc, termlib, curses) reports `LDD FAIL libtermlib its row' and the same for curses -- run, red.
